meta.confidence: Automated pilot snapshot — Complete controlling inputs
meta.notes: Automatically assembled controlled-pilot snapshot from the Morganton weather workflow. Defaults to REVIEWED and never self-designates OPERATIONAL. Daily Downburst Model supplies the reviewed Downburst Index/SPC handoff; NWS Digital Forecast/grid data supply wind, QPF, temperature, snow and ice; MORG ECONet supplies antecedent rainfall and permitted derived soil context; a QC-validated automated vegetation-moisture screening result (or separately validated, same-day qualitative briefing when supplied) is kept separate from calculated forecast risk; Load Stress remains manual.

vegetation_vulnerability.basis: Provisional antecedent-moisture screen (pilot-moisture-screen-v1): 24h rainfall 0.00 in; 72h 0.00 in; 168h 0.00 in. 10/20-cm 24h changes -0.010/-0.010 m3/m3; within-week relative ranks 5.7/5.7. Trigger: no elevated rainfall-plus-wetting screening signal. Within-week ranks are NOT climatological soil-saturation percentiles. A Normal screen does not certify root stability or rule out localized saturated ground, erosion, or hazardous trees. MORG observations are now STALE; this is the last known same-day screen, not an updated live assessment.
vegetation_vulnerability.methodology: Rule-based provisional antecedent moisture screening; not a calibrated tree-failure probability or full tree-failure composite

nws_nbm.notes: Schema source bucket retained for backward compatibility. Actual source is NWS Digital Forecast / NDFD and api.weather.gov grid data for Morganton. Source-aligned 24-hour QPF window 2026-10-20T19:00:00-04:00 through 2026-10-21T19:00:00-04:00, 24 consecutive NWS one-hour QPF slots, no minute-level prorating. Wind gust uses the maximum NWS grid windGust overlapping the same 24-hour window. Minimum temperature uses NWS hourly grid temperature through 72 hours. Snow and ice use NWS grid accumulation intervals conservatively; non-zero partial boundary intervals are unavailable rather than prorated.
